blocks.text: MELBOURNE — A never-before scientifically documented moment between a humpback whale and her stillborn calf has scientists rethinking the depth of the creatures’ inner lives. Following the death of the calf, the mother remained with it for hours and potentially days, touching it with her head and pectoral fin, swimming close beside it, and staring into its eyes. The July 2025 interaction was captured by a Sea World Foundation vessel in the shallow waters of Palm Beach Reef, several hundred meters off the coast of southeast Queensland.
